strings.en: Hah, what're you gonna do/　with moves that obvious?!
Don't underestimate my Raftclans!
I'll show you the power of the Raftclans!
You're in the way! Get lost!
You can't beat us, you hear me?!
Die miserably! I'll help you along!
You get to fight me! Be grateful!
You lot are gonna disappear!
You're an eyesore. I'll crush you!
You guys are the finest prey!
The finest prey's walked right into my trap!
I don't let my prey get away!
Steel Dragons!/　I've been waiting for the chance to fight you!
Steel Dragons.../　I'll crush the so-called hope of the Earthlings!
Once you're gone, the Earthlings are less than trash!
Hmph, a mere counterfeit...
That woman, huh.../　I'll give it a shot, even in this machine.
It won't be like last time. Get ready!
Hah, nice of you to come be my target!
I'm grateful to you. So I'll repay you./　By killing you myself!
Counterfeits and Earthlings.../　I'll wipe out every last eyesore!
It's about time you disappeared,/　Calvina Coulange!
It's about time you made your exit, Bellzelute!
Because of you, Lord Al-Van...!/　You've ruined everything, Calvina!/　Just disappear, right now!
Calvina Coulange.../　I'll finish you with my own hands!
Someone like you piloting a Throne Unit?/　That's not supposed to happen!
Granteed or not,/　if the pilot's a brat like you!
That machine's not something/　the likes of you get to use!
Get out of my way!/　I'll deal with you nice and slow after I kill that woman!
Tch, a new Hückebein model...?
Bolting on all that fancy junk!/　The main body's no different from this one, is it?!
Disappear, Hückebein!/　That's your destiny, isn't it?!
Hückebeins are such an eyesore!
Hückebein, I'll wipe you out of existence!
I'll turn you into scrap metal!
Trying to harness a monster.../　I'll never get how lower life-forms think!
I'll crush that counterfeit right now!
Without us, your machine would be nothing!
No need to study that thing! I'll crush it!
Who do you think made it possible/　for you to build that machine?! Huh?!
You should've died in Antarctica!
Earthlings using a copy/　of the Cytron System!
Bigger isn't always better,/　you counterfeit!
That size.../　It's practically begging to be a target!
Vaula, go back to the darkness!
I'll never get how Earthlings think!/　Adding Vaula to their forces!
You'll regret picking a fight with me!
You're an eyesore!
You ain't getting away!
Where do you think you're going, huh?!
You're getting cocky!
You've got guts, aiming at me!
You won't get away with this!
Hold still!
Gaaah! Me, beaten by someone like that?!!
Damn it! Is this it?!
Damn it! Is this the limit for this thing?!!
Damn it! Was that my mistake?!
Guaaah! C-Calvinaaa!!
Th-This is a Raftclans!/　And it's being pushed this far?!
Nngh! Me, beaten by the likes of you?!
Damn it, did I underestimate them?!
A direct hit?! The likes of you, on me?!
There's no way I'd get beaten/　by a bunch like that!
Ngh...!/　The Steel Dragons really are a cut above/　the rest of the Earthlings...!
Not bad, Steel Dragons...!/　That's why taking you down will be worth the glory!
Kh... It may be a prototype,/　but that thing's a new model...!
Tch, if I had a Volrent,/　they wouldn't be pushing me back like this...!
Tch, beaten by the likes of that woman?!
Hah! You never finish the job, do you, Instructor?!
Damn it! You're such a pain!/　Just disappear, Calvina!!
M-My Raftclans!/　A knight's machine, losing to that counterfeit?!/　No way!!
Ngh...!/　So this is what a direct hit from a Throne Unit does!
Damn it! Don't go thinking/　you've mastered that Throne Unit!
Damn it, you're such a pain, you counterfeit!
Damn it! How dare a scavenged copy do this!
Nngh! Screw you!
My Raftclans...!/　I won't forgive you for this!
Hmph, you're not half bad!
Kh! You scratched my machine!
You're gonna pay for this!
Interesting.../　Didn't think the likes of you could go this far!
Tch, you're a real pain, Steel Dragons!
So you're as strong as the data says, Steel Dragons!
This machine might not cut it/　against that one...!
Kh, they've learned my habits...!
Tch, don't think I'm the same as I used to be!
Screw you!/　You can't even run that thing properly on your own!
You just don't know when to quit, Calvina!/　Get out of my sight!
Kh, that's a Throne Unit for you!
Forget the pilot, that Throne Unit's power is no joke!
Noise in the Cytron System...!/　Is that counterfeit interfering?!
Kh! You're getting cocky, you counterfeit!
Don't get carried away,/　you Hückebein knockoff!
I'm being pushed back.../　by a botched Vaula?!
Tch, just a graze.
Tch, landing a hit on a Raftclans...!
This much is nothing!
You hit me...?!
That attack didn't do a thing!
Tch, my evasion was too sloppy!
Well, I figured they'd manage that much./　It's the Steel Dragons, after all.
That's right, at least show me that much./　Otherwise it's not worth fighting.
Hmph... Well, I figured they'd manage that much.
Hmph, I remember that maneuver.
Hahaha, is that all you've got? Huh, Instructor?!
That didn't do a thing, Calvina!
Like that'd work!/　One way or another, you're disappearing here!
That wasn't your skill!/　It was the Throne Unit's performance!
What's wrong?/　Show me more of the Throne Unit's power!/　If you can, that is!
A counterfeit's got the nerve to hit me, huh?
Tch, noise is running through/　the Cytron System!
Hmph, is that it?/　You're even worse than the Hückebein.
Is that all Vaula's power amounts to?!
Like that attack would hit me.
Can't hit me, hahahaha!
Slow, you're so slow!
What a half-hearted attack!
Well, figured you'd do that.
New machine, same old habits!
Hah, I've seen more than enough/　of your maneuvers!
You can't hit me, Calvina!/　Not with your attacks!
Quit wasting your time and just let me kill you!/　Calvina Coulange!
Hmph, Throne Unit or not, not with you lot piloting it!
That machine's not something/　the likes of you get to use!
Is this the limit for a counterfeit? Huh?
Your aim's sloppy./　Guess that's all that system can do.
What were you even aiming at?
I'd dodge even a real Hückebein!
Hahahaha, like that'd work!
Idiot! It's useless!
That was a shallow move!
That stuff doesn't work on me!
That attack was pointless!
Tch, how unlike me...
I can't attack?! Damn it!
Damn it, guess I've gotta reposition!
Damn it, they got into my blind spot!
Are you that scared of me?! Huh?!
Where the hell did that guy go?!
Tch, bad position. Let's try that again.
Hah, you moron!
It ain't over yet!
I'm next after Lord Al-Van!
Impressive, Lord Al-Van!/　I won't give them a moment's rest!
Lady Fu-Ruu, let me get in on this too!
So-Des, out of my way!/　A mere Agent shouldn't butt in!
Tch, making me go to all this trouble!
Lord Al-Van, please fall back./　Leave this to me!
I won't let anyone scratch Lord Al-Van's machine!
Lady Fu-Ruu, I'm moving up front! Excuse me!
Hah, slowpoke. You're not getting away!
Here comes more! Get ready!
I'll finish this!!
Drop dead!
Eat this!
Go down!
There!
Take this!
I'll smash this right into you!
Go down!
Ora ora!
You're mine!
Take that, and that, and that, and that!
Think you can dodge this?!
Here, take it, why don't ya?!
Idiot! Over here!
Go down!
Go down and be my glory!
Hah, got you!
A target should act like one!
Just sit still!
Take a shot of my Orgone Rifle!
Here I go... Shield!
Can you take this?!
At this range!
I'll drive my Claw into you!
Come on, come on, come on!
I'll knock you down!
Hahahahaha!
Drop dead!
I'll blow you all away!
Disappear, all of you!
There's nowhere to run!
Let's do this, with my Orgone Sword!
I'll show you what a knight can do!
Take that!
You can't dodge this one!!
With my sword!
